judgment_refs.phrase: willful or wanton disregard of the safety of persons or property
judgment_refs.note: An interior state and qualitative standard; telemetry, short control requests or contact cannot establish a legal verdict.

sweep_specs.rationale: Two engineering responses are prepared, but legal mental state and original access/encounter facts are not established by worker telemetry.
missing_inputs: Independent original highway or public-access premises and exclusion source review
Independent original worker, driver, physical encounter and pixel review
Authoritative qualitative mental-state interpretation; no worker cutoff supplied

cases.rationale: Unselected shared paved-road and roadside-worker context.
